temporal_caption: At 0:00 a static, high-angle security-camera view from a corner of the room looks down at the wooden table in the middle of the checkered floor, with the white robot arm on it holding the light-blue pitcher beside the glass; the window glows on the far wall. From 0:00 to 0:01 the arm moves the pitcher over the glass. From 0:01 to 0:05 it tilts the pitcher and pours; the stream is small at this distance. From 0:05 to 0:07 it tilts the pitcher back and moves it away.

subjects.description: A white seven-joint robot arm with black joint accents and a two-finger gripper
subjects.appearance_details: Smooth white plastic links, a white gripper, mounted on the edge of the table
subjects.relationship: Holds the pitcher and pours from it into the glass
subjects.action: Carries the pitcher over the glass, tilts it to pour, tilts it back upright and moves it away
subjects.state_changes: Moves smoothly and slowly; the wrist tilts forward to about 75 degrees and back

subjects.description: A light-blue glossy ceramic pitcher with a small pouring lip
subjects.appearance_details: About 16 cm tall, held near its rim by the gripper
subjects.action: Tipped forward so water pours from its lip, then set upright again

subjects.description: A clear drinking glass standing on the table
subjects.appearance_details: Plain transparent glass tumbler, about 11 cm tall
subjects.state_changes: Empty at first, about two-thirds full of water at the end

subjects.description: A thin stream of clear water
subjects.relationship: Flows from the pitcher's lip into the glass
subjects.action: Falls in a smooth arc from the lip into the glass
subjects.state_changes: Starts at about 0:02, steady until about 0:05, then thins and stops

background_setting: A bright, clean lab kitchen: a wooden table in the middle of the room, pale plaster walls, a grey and white checkered tile floor, a white cabinet with a counter along the back wall, a shelf with small colourful jars, a window with daylight and soft ceiling light panels.

lighting.conditions: Bright, even indoor light with daylight from a window
lighting.direction: Soft light from above and from the window
lighting.shadows: Soft shadows under the robot, the pitcher and the glass
lighting.illumination_effect: Highlights on the glossy pitcher, the glass and the water

aesthetics.color_scheme: White robot, light-blue pitcher, clear glass and water, warm wood, pale walls
aesthetics.composition: The table and robot in the middle of the room, walls and floor around them

cinematography.camera_angle: High angle from a ceiling corner

style_medium: CCTV security camera footage, photoreal live-action
context: Real-world footage of a robot arm pouring water into a glass. Realistic real-world video, natural lighting and motion, not a rendering.

actions.description: The robot arm carries the upright pitcher from beside the glass to just above it.
The arm tilts the pitcher forward until water reaches the lip.
A thin, steady stream of water pours from the pitcher's lip into the glass, which fills to about two-thirds.
The arm tilts the pitcher back upright and the stream stops.
The arm moves the pitcher away from the glass.
